changelog:
[COLOR fffdb515]Trakt lists[/COLOR]
-Your Trakt lists now show every item.
-Series with no air day or time on Trakt (many streaming and ended series) are no longer dropped from TV Show Lists.
-Lists keep the order their owner chose on trakt.tv.
-Adding the Trakt watchlist, collection or a list to the Kodi library now imports all of it, not only the first page.
[COLOR fffdb515]Trakt account[/COLOR]
-The connection to Trakt is renewed in the background before it expires. Trakt sign-ins now last 24 hours, and luc_kodi was still counting on three months.
-Authorizing Trakt now tells you straight away when Trakt refuses, for example when a free account already has another community app connected, instead of waiting until the code runs out.
-Deauthorizing Trakt now also disconnects luc_kodi on trakt.tv, so the free community app slot is released for another app.
-luc_kodi now identifies itself to Trakt by name and version, as Trakt requires.
[COLOR fffdb515]Progress[/COLOR]
-Series you drop on Trakt disappear from Progress and Up Next, as they do on trakt.tv. Restoring a series from the Hidden Items manager also brings back dropped series.
-A network cut during a sync no longer empties your hidden series and makes them come back in Progress.
-After each watched episode only the series that changed are re-read from Trakt, instead of every series you have watched. Large profiles no longer run into Trakt's request limit.
-When Trakt is not responding the background sync waits for the next round instead of repeating every request.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-Series and movies without an IMDb ID are now marked as watched on Trakt when they finish. They stayed as "watching now".
-Removing the resume point of an episode from the Playback Progress manager removes that episode's point, not another episode of the same series.
-Liking and unliking lists and removing resume points work again when the Trakt sign-in has just expired.
-Adding a season or an episode to a personal list adds the series, since Trakt lists no longer show single seasons or episodes. The confirmation now shows the list name.
